faq.answer1: KUMBA is a new housing application that reinvents the rental search experience. It offers a user-friendly and intuitive platform to find houses, apartments, guesthouses, offices, real estate agencies, and much more—all without intermediaries.
faq.question2: How does KUMBA simplify the housing search?
faq.answer2: KUMBA removes the hassle of dealing with agents by ensuring a seamless match between rental property listings and tenants, making it easier and more enjoyable to find a place to live.
faq.question3: What types of housing can I find on KUMBA?
faq.answer3: You’ll find a wide range of rental options including houses, apartments, guesthouses, offices, moving services, and other real estate listings.
faq.answer4: By connecting you directly with landlords and property owners, KUMBA removes the need for real estate agents or brokers, saving time and avoiding unnecessary fees.
faq.question5: How do I get started with KUMBA?
faq.answer5: Just download the app, create an account, and start browsing available rental listings. You can customize your search based on your preferences.
faq.question6: Is KUMBA available in my area?
faq.answer6: To check availability in your area, visit the app or website to see the list of supported cities and regions.
faq.question7: How can I contact property owners or managers on KUMBA?
faq.answer7: Each listing includes contact information, so you can message or call property owners or managers directly through the app.
faq.question8: Does KUMBA offer safety features for tenants?
faq.answer8: Yes. KUMBA includes safety features like identity verification, user reviews, and tips to ensure secure communication and transactions.
faq.question9: Are there any fees for using KUMBA?
faq.answer9: Some features are free, while others may involve a subscription or booking fee. Full pricing details are available in the app.
faq.question10: How do I report a problem or get help with KUMBA?
faq.answer10: You can contact our support team directly through the app via the Help or Support section to report any issues or ask questions.
faq.question11: How does KUMBA's affiliate program work?
faq.answer11: Our affiliate program lets you earn money by referring new users. You get a unique referral link and receive commissions when your referrals use the platform.
faq.question12: How can I join the KUMBA affiliate program?
faq.answer12: Create an account in the app, go to the 'Affiliate' section, and follow the steps to generate your referral link and start sharing.
faq.question13: How can I earn money with the affiliate program?
faq.answer13: You earn a commission each time someone signs up using your link and completes a rental transaction on the platform.
faq.question14: How can I track my affiliate commissions and earnings?
faq.answer14: Your affiliate dashboard lets you monitor your sign-ups, earnings, and commission history, with regular updates on your performance.
faq.question15: What are the benefits of KUMBA’s affiliate program?
faq.answer15: It’s a great way to earn passive income while promoting a useful service. You also get flexible working conditions and help expand the community.
faq.question16: Are there any special requirements to become a KUMBA affiliate?
faq.answer16: You need an active KUMBA account and must comply with our terms of service and affiliate program rules.
faq.question17: How can I withdraw my affiliate earnings?
faq.answer17: Once you reach the minimum threshold, you can withdraw via MTN Money, Moov Money, or Celtis Money—whichever works best for you.
faq.question18: Where can I learn more about KUMBA’s affiliate program?
faq.answer18: Visit the 'Affiliate' section in the app or on the website to learn more about commissions, conditions, and how to get started.
